concept.name: Pythagoras' theorem
concept.subject: Maths
concept.prompt_text: In a right-angled triangle, the longest side is called the hypotenuse. The square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <title>Pythagorean Theorem: a² + b² = c²</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #0f172a; }
    .grid { stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 1; }
    .triangle-fill { fill: #38bdf8; opacity: 0.2; }
    .triangle-stroke { stroke: #38bdf8; stroke-width: 3; fill: none; }
    
    .square-a { fill: #f43f5e; opacity: 0.5; stroke: #fb7185; stroke-width: 2; }
    .square-b { fill: #10b981; opacity: 0.5; stroke: #34d399; stroke-width: 2; }
    .square-c { fill: #8b5cf6; opacity: 0.5; stroke: #a78bfa; stroke-width: 2; }
    
    .label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #f8fafc; }
    .formula { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; fill: #38bdf8; }
    .subtext { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; fill: #94a3b8; }
    
    .pulse {
      animation: pulseAnim 3s infinite alternate ease-in-out;
    }
    
    @keyframes pulseAnim {
      0% { opacity: 0.4; }
      50% { opacity: 0.7; }
      100% { opacity: 0.4; }
    }
    
    .draw-line {
      stroke-dasharray: 400;
      stroke-dashoffset: 400;
      animation: draw 2s forwards ease-out;
    }
    
    @keyframes draw {
      to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" class="bg" />
  
  <!-- Subtle Grid Lines -->
  <g class="grid">
    <line x1="100" y1="100" x2="100" y2="500" />
    <line x1="200" y1="100" x2="200" y2="500" />
    <line x1="300" y1="100" x2="300" y2="500" />
    <line x1="400" y1="100" x2="400" y2="500" />
    <line x1="500" y1="100" x2="500" y2="500" />
    <line x1="600" y1="100" x2="600" y2="500" />
    <line x1="700" y1="100" x2="700" y2="500" />
    
    <line x1="100" y1="100" x2="700" y2="100" />
    <line x1="100" y1="200" x2="700" y2="200" />
    <line x1="100" y1="300" x2="700" y2="300" />
    <line x1="100" y1="400" x2="700" y2="400" />
    <line x1="100" y1="500" x2="700" y2="500" />
  </g>

  <!-- Title & Formula Header -->
  <text x="400" y="55" text-anchor="middle" class="formula">Pythagorean Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>
  
  <!-- 
    Triangle Coordinates:
    Right angle at (300, 400)
    Vertex A (top) at (300, 250) -> side b = 150 px (upwards)
    Vertex B (right) at (450, 400) -> side a = 150 px (rightwards)
    Hypotenuse c connects (300, 250) to (450, 400) -> length = sqrt(150^2 + 150^2) ≈ 212.13 px
  -->

  <!-- Squares on sides -->
  <!-- Square a (bottom, 150x150, from 300,400 to 450,550) -->
  <rect x="300" y="400" width="150" height="150" class="square-a pulse" />
  <text x="375" y="480" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#fda4af">a²</text>

  <!-- Square b (left, 150x150, from 150,250 to 300,400) -->
  <rect x="150" y="250" width="150" height="150" class="square-b pulse" />
  <text x="225" y="335" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#6ee7b7">b²</text>

  <!-- Square c (Hypotenuse side, rotated) -->
  <!-- 
    Vector for hypotenuse: from (300,250) to (450,400). 
    Perpendicular outward vector: (-150, 150).
    Square vertices: 
    1: (300, 250)
    2: (450, 400)
    3: (300, 550)
    4: (150, 400)
    Let's draw this square rotated along the hypotenuse.
  -->
  <polygon points="300,250 450,400 300,550 150,400" class="square-c pulse" />
  <text x="300" y="410" text-anchor="middle" class="label" fill="#c4b5fd">c²</text>

  <!-- Triangle fill & stroke -->
  <polygon points="300,400 300,250 450,400" class="triangle-fill" />
  <polygon points="300,400 300,250 450,400" class="triangle-stroke draw-line" />

  <!-- Right Angle Indicator -->
  <polyline points="300,380 320,380 320,400" fill="none" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Side Labels -->
  <text x="375" y="425" text-anchor="middle" class="label">a</text>
  <text x="280" y="335" text-anchor="middle" class="label">b</text>
  <text x="390" y="315" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Hypotenuse (c)</text>

  <!-- Educational Explanatory Subtext -->
  <text x="400" y="570" text-anchor="middle" class="subtext">The area of the blue square (c²) equals the sum of the red (a²) and green (b²) areas.</text>

</svg>

concept.name: Parts of a circle
concept.subject: Maths
concept.prompt_text: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <title>Circle Geometry: Centre, Radius, Diameter, and Circumference</title>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #f8fafc; }
    .circle-base { fill: #e0f2fe; stroke: #0284c7; stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 8 4; }
    .circumference-path { fill: none; stroke: #ea580c; stroke-width: 6; stroke-dasharray: 600; stroke-dashoffset: 600; animation: drawCircumference 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .radius-line { stroke: #16a34a; stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 200; stroke-dashoffset: 200; animation: drawRadius 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .diameter-line { stroke: #9333ea; stroke-width: 4; stroke-dasharray: 400; stroke-dashoffset: 400; animation: drawDiameter 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .centre-dot { fill: #000000; animation: pulseCentre 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; fill: #334155; }
    .title-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold; fill: #0f172a; text-anchor: middle; }
    .sub-text { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #64748b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .legend-box { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 1.5; rx: 8; }
    
    @keyframes drawCircumference {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 600; }
      50%, 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    
    @keyframes drawDiameter {
      0%, 20% { stroke-dashoffset: 400; }
      70%, 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    
    @keyframes drawRadius {
      0%, 40% { stroke-dashoffset: 200; }
      90%, 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
    
    @keyframes pulseCentre {
      0%, 50% { r: 0; }
      70%, 100% { r: 6; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" class="bg" />

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="45" class="title-text">Properties of a Circle</text>
  <text x="400" y="70" class="sub-text">Visualizing Centre, Radius, Diameter, and Circumference</text>

  <!-- Main Circle Elements -->
  <g transform="translate(350, 340)">
    <!-- Base filled circle -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="180" class="circle-base" />

    <!-- Diameter (Purple) passing through center -->
    <line x1="-180" y1="0" x2="180" y2="0" class="diameter-line" />

    <!-- Radius (Green) from center to right edge -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="180" y2="0" class="radius-line" />

    <!-- Circumference (Orange) animated stroke -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="180" class="circumference-path" />

    <!-- Centre Point -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" class="centre-dot" />

    <!-- Diagram Labels -->
    <text x="90" y="-15" fill="#16a34a" class="label">Radius (r)</text>
    <text x="0" y="-25" fill="#9333ea" class="label" text-anchor="middle">Diameter (d = 2r)</text>
    <text x="130" y="130" fill="#ea580c" class="label">Circumference</text>
    <text x="-10" y="25" class="label">Centre</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Legend / Explanations Panel -->
  <g transform="translate(560, 150)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="210" height="380" class="legend-box" />
    
    <text x="15" y="30" class="label" font-size="16" fill="#0f172a">Key Terms:</text>
    
    <!-- Centre Legend -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="70" r="5" fill="#000000" />
    <text x="45" y="75" class="label" font-size="14">Centre:</text>
    <text x="45" y="95" class="sub-text" text-anchor="start" font-size="13">The exact middle point.</text>

    <!-- Radius Legend -->
    <line x1="15" y1="140" x2="35" y2="140" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="45" y="145" class="label" font-size="14">Radius:</text>
    <text x="45" y="165" class="sub-text" text-anchor="start" font-size="13">Centre to edge.</text>

    <!-- Diameter Legend -->
    <line x1="15" y1="210" x2="35" y2="210" stroke="#9333ea" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="45" y="215" class="label" font-size="14">Diameter:</text>
    <text x="45" y="235" class="sub-text" text-anchor="start" font-size="13">Edge to edge through</text>
    <text x="45" y="253" class="sub-text" text-anchor="start" font-size="13">the centre (2 × radius).</text>

    <!-- Circumference Legend -->
    <circle cx="25" cy="305" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#ea580c" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="45" y="310" class="label" font-size="14">Circumference:</text>
    <text x="45" y="330" class="sub-text" text-anchor="start" font-size="13">The distance all</text>
    <text x="45" y="348" class="sub-text" text-anchor="start" font-size="13">the way around.</text>
  </g>
</svg>

concept.name: Series circuit
concept.subject: Physics
concept.prompt_text: In a series circuit there is only one loop. The current is the same everywhere in the loop. The voltage of the cell is shared between the components.

svg:

concept.name: Photosynthesis
concept.subject: Biology
concept.prompt_text: Plants take in carbon dioxide and water. They use light energy, absorbed by chlorophyll, to make glucose and oxygen.

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <title>Photosynthesis Process Diagram</title>
  
  <style>
    /* Background & Global Styles */
    .bg { fill: #f0f7f4; }
    
    /* Typography */
    .title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold; fill: #2c5e3b; text-anchor: middle; }
    .label { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #333333; text-anchor: middle; }
    .sublabel { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #555555; text-anchor: middle; }
    
    /* Sun rays animation */
    .sun-ray {
      fill: #ffeb3b;
      opacity: 0.6;
      transform-origin: 150px 150px;
      animation: pulse-ray 4s infinite alternate;
    }
    
    @keyframes pulse-ray {
      0% { transform: scale(0.95); opacity: 0.4; }
      100% { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 0.8; }
    }

    /* Particle flow animations */
    .input-particle {
      animation: move-to-plant 3s infinite linear;
    }
    
    .output-particle {
      animation: move-from-plant 3s infinite linear;
    }

    @keyframes move-to-plant {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 1; }
      80% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(var(--tx), var(--ty)); opacity: 0; }
    }

    @keyframes move-from-plant {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); opacity: 0; }
      20% { opacity: 1; }
      80% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translate(var(--tx), var(--ty)); opacity: 0; }
    }

    /* Leaf glow effect */
    .chloroplast {
      animation: glow 2s infinite alternate;
    }
    @keyframes glow {
      0% { fill: #4caf50; }
      100% { fill: #81c784; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" class="bg" />

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="45" class="title">Photosynthesis in Plants</text>

  <!-- ==================== SUN (Light Energy) ==================== -->
  <g id="sun">
    <circle cx="150" cy="130" r="45" fill="#ffc107" />
    <!-- Sun Rays -->
    <path class="sun-ray" d="M150 65 L150 40 M150 195 L150 220 M85 130 L60 130 M215 130 L240 130 M104 84 L86 66 M196 176 L214 194 M104 176 L86 194 M196 84 L214 66" stroke="#ffc107" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" />
    <text x="150" y="200" class="label" fill="#e65100">Light Energy</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ==================== PLANT ==================== -->
  <g id="plant" transform="translate(400, 340)">
    <!-- Roots -->
    <path d="M0 60 C -30 90, -70 110, -100 130 M0 60 C 0 100, -20 130, -40 150 M0 60 C 30 90, 60 120, 90 140" fill="none" stroke="#8d6e63" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" />
    
    <!-- Pot/Soil -->
    <path d="M-80 60 L80 60 L60 160 L-60 160 Z" fill="#d7ccc8" stroke="#a1887f" stroke-width="4" />
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="60" rx="80" ry="15" fill="#a1887f" />
    
    <!-- Stem -->
    <path d="M0 60 C -10 -10, 10 -80, 0 -140" fill="none" stroke="#689f38" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" />

    <!-- Left Leaf -->
    <path d="M -5 -70 C -60 -90, -100 -40, -50 -10 C -30 -10, -15 -30, -5 -70" fill="#4caf50" class="chloroplast" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- Right Leaf -->
    <path d="M 5 -100 C 60 -120, 100 -70, 50 -40 C 30 -40, 15 -60, 5 -100" fill="#4caf50" class="chloroplast" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Plant Label -->
    <text x="0" y="195" class="label">Green Plant</text>
    <text x="0" y="215" class="sublabel">(Chlorophyll in leaves)</text>
  </g>


  <!-- ==================== INPUTS (Left Side) ==================== -->
  
  <!-- Carbon Dioxide -->
  <g id="co2-input" transform="translate(180, 290)">
    <rect x="-70" y="-20" width="140" height="40" rx="20" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#00acc1" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="0" y="5" class="label" font-size="15" fill="#006064">Carbon Dioxide</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" class="sublabel">From Air (CO₂)</text>
  </g>
  <path d="M 250 290 Q 325 290 380 290" fill="none" stroke="#00acc1" stroke-dasharray="6,6" stroke-width="3" />

  <!-- Water -->
  <g id="h2o-input" transform="translate(180, 440)">
    <rect x="-60" y="-20" width="120" height="40" rx="20" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1e88e5" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="0" y="5" class="label" font-size="15" fill="#0d47a1">Water</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" class="sublabel">From Soil (H₂O)</text>
  </g>
  <path d="M 240 440 Q 310 440 350 410" fill="none" stroke="#1e88e5" stroke-dasharray="6,6" stroke-width="3" />


  <!-- ==================== OUTPUTS (Right Side) ==================== -->

  <!-- Oxygen -->
  <g id="o2-output" transform="translate(620, 270)">
    <rect x="-60" y="-20" width="120" height="40" rx="20" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#43a047" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="0" y="5" class="label" font-size="15" fill="#1b5e20">Oxygen</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" class="sublabel">Released (O₂)</text>
  </g>
  <path d="M 420 250 Q 500 270 560 270" fill="none" stroke="#43a047" stroke-dasharray="6,6" stroke-width="3" />

  <!-- Glucose -->
  <g id="glucose-output" transform="translate(620, 410)">
    <rect x="-60" y="-20" width="120" height="40" rx="20" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#fb8c00" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="0" y="5" class="label" font-size="15" fill="#e65100">Glucose</text>
    <text x="0" y="22" class="sublabel">Plant Food (C₆H₁₂O₆)</text>
  </g>
  <path d="M 420 330 Q 500 370 560 410" fill="none" stroke="#fb8c00" stroke-dasharray="6,6" stroke-width="3" />


  <!-- ==================== ANIMATED PARTICLES ==================== -->
  
  <!-- CO2 Particles moving IN -->
  <g>
    <circle r="6" fill="#00acc1" class="input-particle" style="--tx: 170px; --ty: 0px;" cx="180" cy="290" />
    <circle r="6" fill="#00acc1" class="input-particle" style="--tx: 170px; --ty: 0px; animation-delay: 1.5s;" cx="180" cy="290" />
  </g>

  <!-- H2O Particles moving IN -->
  <g>
    <circle r="6" fill="#1e88e5" class="input-particle" style="--tx: 170px; --ty: -30px; animation-delay: 0.7s;" cx="180" cy="440" />
    <circle r="6" fill="#1e88e5" class="input-particle" style="--tx: 170px; --ty: -30px; animation-delay: 2.2s;" cx="180" cy="440" />
  </g>

  <!-- O2 Particles moving OUT -->
  <g>
    <circle r="6" fill="#43a047" class="output-particle" style="--tx: 140px; --ty: 0px; animation-delay: 0.5s;" cx="480" cy="270" />
    <circle r="6" fill="#43a047" class="output-particle" style="--tx: 140px; --ty: 0px; animation-delay: 2.0s;" cx="480" cy="270" />
  </g>

  <!-- Glucose Particles moving OUT -->
  <g>
    <circle r="6" fill="#fb8c00" class="output-particle" style="--tx: 140px; --ty: 40px; animation-delay: 1.2s;" cx="480" cy="370" />
    <circle r="6" fill="#fb8c00" class="output-particle" style="--tx: 140px; --ty: 40px; animation-delay: 2.7s;" cx="480" cy="370" />
  </g>

</svg>

concept.name: States of matter
concept.subject: Chemistry
concept.prompt_text: In a solid the particles are close together and vibrate in place. In a liquid they are close but move past each other. In a gas they are far apart and move fast.

svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 450">
  <title>States of Matter - Particle Motion</title>
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #0d1117; }
    .container-box { fill: #161b22; stroke: #30363d; stroke-width: 3; rx: 15; }
    .title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; fill: #e6edf3; text-anchor: middle; }
    .subtitle { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #8b949e; text-anchor: middle; }
    .particle-solid { fill: #58a6ff; stroke: #1f6feb; stroke-width: 2; }
    .particle-liquid { fill: #3fb950; stroke: #238636; stroke-width: 2; }
    .particle-gas { fill: #f85149; stroke: #da3633; stroke-width: 2; }

    /* Animations */
    @keyframes vibrate {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      20% { transform: translate(-2px, 2px); }
      40% { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }
      60% { transform: translate(-1px, -2px); }
      80% { transform: translate(2px, 1px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes flow1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(15px, -10px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-10px, 15px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes flow2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(-15px, 12px); }
      66% { transform: translate(12px, -15px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes flow3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      33% { transform: translate(10px, 15px); }
      66% { transform: translate(-15px, -10px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes fly1 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-70px, -50px); }
      50% { transform: translate(60px, -80px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-40px, 70px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes fly2 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(80px, 40px); }
      50% { transform: translate(-60px, 60px); }
      75% { transform: translate(50px, -70px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    @keyframes fly3 {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
      25% { transform: translate(-50px, -70px); }
      50% { transform: translate(70px, 50px); }
      75% { transform: translate(-80px, -30px); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    }

    .v1 { animation: vibrate 0.4s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }
    .v2 { animation: vibrate 0.35s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .v3 { animation: vibrate 0.45s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; animation-delay: 0.2s; }

    .f1 { animation: flow1 2s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }
    .f2 { animation: flow2 2.3s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }
    .f3 { animation: flow3 1.8s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }

    .g1 { animation: fly1 1.2s infinite linear; transform-origin: center; }
    .g2 { animation: fly2 0.9s infinite linear; transform-origin: center; }
    .g3 { animation: fly3 1.0s infinite linear; transform-origin: center; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" class="bg"/>
